correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Petersen as KG(5,2) on ten two-subsets with 15 edges. Exhaustive forbidden-induced-P4 enumeration finds 60 bad quadruples; all 1024 masks tested, giving 390 nonempty faces, f=(10,45,120,150,60,5). Separately reconstructed the specified 187 greedy face pairs; full directed Hasse graph acyclic (390 nodes, 1380 incidences). Exact chain cancellation yields claimed 13-by-2 Morse boundary with a unimodular 2-minor: two three/four cell pairs cancel homotopically leaving wedge of eleven S3, not just rational homology. Independently recomputed all 120 orientation-sensitive fixed-simplex traces and S5 character (11,-3,-1,2,0,-1,1); Specht decomposition dims 6+4+1. The computation is finite and exhaustive for the ten-vertex graph, not a claim about all Kneser graphs.

originality.rationale: The relevant mathematical objects are P4-devoid complexes and cograph-induced vertex subsets, not Petersen independence or cut complexes. Prior path/cycle devoid results have nonapplicable graph-family hypotheses. Two same-graph indexed findings have different face predicates; the complementary triangular four-cut complex even has the same rank 11 but different S5 character. Full-text access for Taylan was not secured in this run: a publisher preview/abstract, exact theorem descriptions and source citations were considered, and full comparison remains a real residual priority risk. None of the inspected propositions implies the Petersen-specific Morse or S5 theorem.

value.rationale: P4-free induced subgraphs are precisely star forests on the girth-five Petersen graph. The integral homotopy and full natural S5 symmetry representation of this canonical forbidden-pattern complex expose eleven sphere generators rather than the single S3 of the 2-independence subcomplex, with a sign line but no invariant vector. This is a motivated exact invariant for a natural finite graph and forbidden motif, beyond routine recomputation.
